rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken expression when something is located directly in front.

example.english: The bus is ahead, so hurry and catch it.
example.traditional: 架巴士喺前面，快啲追啦。
example.jyutping: gaa3 baa1 si6 hai2 cin4 min6 faai3 di1 zeoi1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for future time, especially when talking about what will happen later.

example.english: Looking ahead, I want to live closer to the sea.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 loi4 ngo5 soeng2 zyu6 gan6 di1 hoi2

rows.traditional: A 領先 B + N + V
rows.jyutping: A ling5 sin1 B N V
rows.note: Use this race or progress pattern when A is ahead of B by an amount while doing V.

example.english: Ming is three metres ahead of Cheung while running.
example.traditional: 阿明領先阿強三米跑緊。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 ling5 sin1 aa3 koeng4 saam1 mai5 paau2 gan2

rows.note: Use this when something is done beforehand or paid before the relevant time.

example.english: You have to buy the tickets ahead of time.
example.jyutping: mun4 piu3 jiu3 jyu6 sin1 maai5 gaa3
